summary: Digital Brands Group, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a Securities Purchase Agreement with a single purchaser for a $3,529,412 unsecured convertible promissory note (net proceeds ~$3M after 0.85 discount). Maturity Jan 23, 2027; scheduled repayments of $1M on Oct 23, Nov 23, Dec 23, 2026, and $529,412 at maturity. Default interest at 20% p.a. Aegis Capital Corp. served as placement agent on a best-efforts basis, earning 3% commission on subscription and 3% on future ELOC put shares. Proceeds for working capital and liability repayment. No premium, share price, or strategic transaction. Classified as a debt financing, not a special situation.
